name: THE NEVER-ENDING SLEEPOVER
source:
14 year old Yuria Oosumi is a lonely girl without many friends. When she meets an interesting girl after school, will she follow her to her "Sleepover Realm" ?

[From [url=https://danananproject.itch.io/the-never-ending-sleepover]itch.io[/url]]
